title: terragucci.estate/v1
description: estate.json at the top of a reports prefix, which terragucci estate builds from every project's index.json, inventory.json and changes.json. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

generated.description: When the page was built, ISO 8601. Every age on it is as of this time.

unreadable.description: Projects whose index could not be read.

overridden_roots.description: Roots the newest apply waves applied under a policy override. Absent when none.

resources.description: Resources across every project's inventory. Absent when no project has one.

recent.description: The 20 newest runs across every project, newest first.

audit.description: The audit trail beside the page, when terragucci audit wrote one.

history.description: The resource history beside the page (history.json and history.html), when an apply changed a resource.

resources.description: Addresses with at least one apply.

dora.description: The DORA metrics beside the page (dora.json, terragucci.dora/v1).

deployments.description: The estate's applied waves in the metrics' window.

graph.description: The dependency graph, from the run view of each project's newest applied commit: every root by wave, and an edge from each root to each root that reads its state through terraform_remote_state. An edge between two projects matched a read of a state outside the reader's project to the root of the other that holds it. Absent when no project has a run view.

edges.description: Each edge: to reads the state of from.

run.description: A run, from its index row.

share.description: The share of a tf-apply wave split across jobs.

destroys.description: How many destroys and replacements the run has.

report.description: The run's report.html, relative to the page or absolute on another bucket's address. Absent when the page cannot link it.

since.description: When the wave began waiting for an approval of its digest.

age_seconds.description: Seconds it had waited at generated.

error.description: Why the index could not be read.

index.description: The project's index.html, when the page can link it.

apply.description: The waves of the newest commit that ran tf-apply, by wave number.

drifted.description: Roots that drifted in the latest drift check.

failed.description: Roots that failed in the latest plan, drift check and apply waves.

overridden.description: Roots the newest commit's apply waves applied under a policy override. Absent when none.

inventory.description: The resources its roots hold, from its inventory.json. Absent until an apply records them.

states.description: Each root's state versions, from its states.json. Absent until an apply records them.

run_view.description: The run view of the project's newest applied commit, which the dependency graph read: its commit, when a wave last wrote it, and its run.html when the page can link it. Absent until a wave writes one.

stateRoot.description: One root's state: where it is, whether its backend keeps versions, and the version ids its applies left, newest first. Never the state's contents.

checked.description: When the newest apply that recorded the root finished.

report.description: The wave's report.html, when the page can link it.

types.description: How many resources of each type, most first.

items.description: One root's resources, as its newest applied wave left them.

report.description: The wave's report.html, when the page can link it.

history.description: Its section of history.html, when an apply changed it.
